definitions.arrival_collision_bounds: Copied independently from each original result.json; no combined pass rule is added.
definitions.speed: Euclidean norm of states[:,7:10] and references[:,:,1] at the recorded control timestamps.
definitions.motion_start: First recorded actual speed above the existing 0.5 m/s diagnostic threshold.
definitions.elapsed_from_first_motion: Run end minus first-motion timestamp; includes subsequent pauses and settling.
definitions.time_above_motion_threshold: Recorded step durations whose actual speed exceeds 0.5 m/s.
definitions.pause: Existing timeline.json definition: after motion starts, actual speed below 0.2 m/s for at least 0.2 s, more than 1 m from the resolved goal.
definitions.backup_intervals: Intervals of the recorded published on_backup flag. The flag can remain true after command duration when no new command is published; it does not imply an active moving backup segment.
definitions.planner_total: timings.total_s for all returned requests, including failures and requests without a new trajectory.
definitions.cycle_including_sensor_and_delivery: cycle_wall_s from submission to receipt; includes sensor and map update when requested, worker execution, IPC and result polling.
definitions.worker_including_sensor: worker_s includes requested sensor and map work, but excludes parent submission and delivery overhead.
definitions.requests_with_exp_optimization: All requests containing timings.exp_opt_s, regardless of success; statistics use each selected request's complete total_s / cycle_wall_s.
definitions.module_statistics: Only requests containing the named module contribute; each statistic records its sample count.
definitions.quantiles: NumPy linear sample quantiles; nonfinite values are counted explicitly and excluded from finite quantiles.
definitions.plots: Planning values are plotted at their recorded result_t; each seed's speed and planning panels share simulation time. No solver deadline line is added.
definitions.raw_file_manifest: Hashes cover the seven original files used for outcomes, intervals, metrics, curves and per-run source provenance; per-plan geometry files are not duplicated in this summary.
definitions.source_hashes: Each run's own source_hashes.json is retained; scene-level historical snapshots are not used.

outcome.arrival_rule: within 0.1 m of the source-resolved goal and below 0.3 m/s for 0.5 s

execution.time_contract: independent CPU planner and continuously advancing Newton simulation; source trajectory timestamps and source commit rules
execution.reference_contract: last published command applied over the recorded Newton step; command_time stores its simulation timestamp

scene_provenance.provenance: existing Dense reconstructed; not a claimed original published map
